description.value: A private, motorcycle-focused campground on 34 forested acres beside Kootenay Lake on Highway 31, with flush toilets, showers, coin-op laundry, and a social pavilion; seasonal summer operation with cash or e-transfer payment only, and Ainsworth Hot Springs five minutes away.

raw_osm.description: Situated on 34 forested acres, with treed campsites throughout. There is a large “social pavilion” with a pool table, and music
raw_osm.name: Toad Rock Motorcycle Campground

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is current and detailed (2025 season updates confirmed), closely matching the OSM record. The About Toad Rock page explicitly lists on-site amenities including showers, coin-op laundry, pavilion, ice, firewood, and WiFi, and nearby food options. The site is motorcycle-themed but states 'All Campers Welcome,' and its location at the junction of BC's top bike roads makes it relevant to cycle tourers. One email discrepancy was noted between OSM and a January 2025 news post.
concerns: Site is explicitly motorcycle-themed ('Motorcycle Campground'); cycle tourists are welcome per 'All Campers Welcome' language but the listing should note the motorcycle orientation.

OSM contact email (information@toadrockcampground.com) differs from the email referenced in the January 2025 news post (stay@toadrockcampground.com), suggesting the contact address may have been updated.
January 2025 news post states payment is accepted by cash or e-transfer only — no credit cards mentioned.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Toad Rock is a well-established, actively operating campground with strong amenities (showers, laundry, covered pavilion, reservations, ice) that would serve touring cyclists well, despite its motorcycle branding. Its location near top-rated BC riding roads and the free Kootenay Lake ferry makes it a genuinely useful stop for cycle tourers.
enrichment_extras.notes: WiFi is listed as an on-site amenity on the About page; device charging stations are not specifically mentioned so that field is left null.

wow_evidence: flush toilets, showers, coin-op laundry, and a social pavilion
